# 3-person meeting agenda and one-day event plan

**Co-work:** 최한길 (석사; hackathon registration Team Leader), 손호성 (서강대학교 가상융합전문대학원 박사과정), 이진명 (같은 대학원 박사과정). Workstreams and intellectual-property ownership are proposals pending joint agreement. None is treated as sole owner of the collaborative project.

Before event (subject to organizer's pre-build rules): review live checkpoint, API/GPU entitlement, rights of previous code and datasets, test scripts. Rehearse on actual hardware if permitted. Prioritize correct demo rather than 3-domain integration.

| Slot | Shared target | Stop rule |
|---|---|---|
| 11/19 13–16 | model endpoint or explicit fixture | no pretending simulated score is live |
| 16–20 | safe policy + evidence spans + normal/scam contrast | fail-closed tests green |
| 20–24 | two-pane user/judge UI + replay; P0 done | no extra model families |
| 11/20 00–04 | targeted adversarial trials + measure | no tuning on locked holdout |
| 04–08 | refine UX and backup recording, power/network test | no live banking/phone integrations |
| 08–12 | freeze, rehearsal, final pitch | no last-minute new features |

User-screen: brief risk request, literal observed quote, safe next action. Judge-screen: model mode, checkpoint, decision options, policy rule, input span, runtime timings, scenario ID, limitations. 90-second demo is the default fallback; adapt to actual announced pitch duration.

Required go/no-go: exactly one project P0, actual model demonstration if available, honest fallback status, minimum 8 end-to-end examples, no real world side effects, original design identity, team agreement on IP and disclosure.
